title: Go Toolchain, Modules, and Packages
summary: Use modules, packages, formatting, compilation, tests, and diagnostics in a repeatable Go workflow.

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: A Go module records an import path and dependency requirements in `go.mod`. Create one with `go mod init`, format source with `gofmt`, run packages with `go run`, build with `go build`, and test with `go test`. Every source file begins with a package declaration; executable programs use package `main` and a `main` function. Imported names start with the package qualifier. Go rejects unused imports and local variables, keeping builds explicit. Read the earliest relevant diagnostic, correct one cause, format, and rebuild rather than running stale output.
keyPoints: A Go module records an import path and dependency requirements in `go.mod`.
commonMistakes: changing module identity breaks import assumptions
manual formatting conventions create needless drift
